name: dropkick_bomber_goblin_flies_then_is_sacrificed
notes: M7 mapper. Printed: 'Other Goblins you control get +1/+1. {R}: Until end of turn, another target Goblin you control gains flying and "When this creature deals combat damage, sacrifice it."' Seat 0 pays {R} targeting its Goblin Raider (1/1, 2/2 with the anthem); it attacks with flying, so Opp Ogre (no flying, no reach) cannot block it; it deals 2 combat damage to seat 1, then its granted trigger sacrifices it. The Bomber stays.
